patchNotes: Restored native-hook support for BMX Streets build 26071101 with a complete audit of 17 native targets. Updated the equip completion coroutine and drone firing signatures, restoring the hooks used by custom hair and materials, manual IK, grind remapping, landing assistance, drone placement, host limits, player labels, tweak control, and nose-manual control. Preserves support for the previously audited build and continues to reject unknown binaries and shared native getters.
